scope_note: F-250 and F-350 Super Duty pickups only; F-450+ and chassis cabs excluded. NHRA file is empty for this model. EPA has rows only for 1999 (heavy-duty trucks exempt); its 1999 4.6 V8 row is the light-duty F-250, not the Super Duty. Source counting: all Ford material = 1, Wikipedia = 1, KBB = 1, Diesel Hub = 1, Drivingline = 1, each other publication = 1. All engines were offered in both F-250 and F-350 (SRW and DRW) unless noted; none found F-350-only. Ratings are SAE net (SAE J1349/J2723 as published).
